components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a task, such as sign-in.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0071E3; color: #FFFFFF; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; font-family: "SF Pro Text", -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0A84FF; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071E3; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: "SF Pro Text", -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-field span { color: #1D1D1F; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-input { height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #D2D2D7; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1D1D1F; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0071E3; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,113,227,0.3); }

components.name: Desk Card
components.description: One task on a white card. Login uses this for the sign-in form.
components.html:
Iniciar sesión

Usuario y contraseña en una sola superficie.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; color: #1D1D1F; border-radius: 28px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); font-family: "SF Pro Text", -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #6E6E73; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Sidebar Item
components.description: Current destination in the desk sidebar.

narrative.overview:
The name is inferred from the incumbent system, not from an interview. tokens.ts already commits the product app to macOS Sequoia: SF Pro, San Francisco Blue (#0071E3, owner decision #1365), paper neutrals, and soft elevation. The desk metaphor is the notary's working surface. One seal color. Generous margins. The task sits on a white card. Chrome recedes.

Operate mode governs login, the shell, forms, tables, and the dashboard. Scanability and the existing tokens outrank expression. GitHub Pages (github-page/) is a separate Persuade surface and is not described here.

Density is comfortable, not sparse: 16px between fields, 24px between sections, 32px inside a card. Motion is a short rise (4px, 120–240ms) that confirms a state. It does not spin, spring, or play a page-load sequence.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, used for the primary action, the current nav item, and links.
SF Pro for every UI role. No display face in labels or tables.
Opacity and transform only, from frontend/src/theme/motion.ts.

rules.name: The One Seal Rule
rules.body: San Francisco Blue covers the primary action, the current navigation item, and focus. It is not a tint for every icon well, and it is not a gradient.

rules.name: The Status Is Not Brand Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and error-text are status only. Error text uses colors.error-text so it stays above 4.5:1 on white.

rules.name: The One Heading Rule
rules.body: A screen has one h1. The task title inside a card is an h2. Do not stack a product name, a subtitle, and the task title at neighboring sizes with no grouping.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Lifted Rule
rules.body: A control does not float at rest. Hover may lift a dashboard card by a few pixels; press is scale(0.98). Login does not lift.

dos: Do take color, type, radius, spacing, and motion from frontend/src/theme/tokens.ts and motion.ts.
Do build forms as FormContainer, FormSection, FormField, FormActions.
Do give an empty list a title, a reason, and one next action when the screen can offer one.
Do keep primary buttons at least 44px tall on touch (sizes.button.lg is 48px).
donts: Don't introduce a second accent, a purple gradient, or a cream AI palette. The paper neutrals are already the warmth.
Don't rotate, spring, or stagger more than six items at 30ms on an Operate surface.
Don't set body or label text in neutral.500 (#A2A2A6).
Don't put the task title, the product name, and a subtitle in one undifferentiated stack.
Don't copy this Operate restraint onto github-page/ as if it were the same mode.
